This site documents the R-based single-cell analysis workflow for Lazic et al.
The workflow accompanies the image-processing pipeline
[MapMetIP](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetIP) and the code in the
[MapMetSC](https://github.com/TaschnerMandlGroup/MapMetSC) repository.

The steps below are run in order. To reproduce the whole pipeline, set the four
data paths in `run_analysis.R` (in the repository root) and run it; each step
reads the object saved by the previous step.

## Main pipeline

0. [Cohort overview](00_cohort_overview.html)
1. [Read single-cell and meta-data](01_read_data.html)
2. [Quality control – part 1](02_QC_1.html)
3. [Quality control – part 2](03_QC_2.html)
4. [Cell phenotyping](04_phenotyping.html)
5. Primary-tumor differential analyses
    - [5.1 Cellular communities](05.1_PT_DE_cellularcomm.html)
    - [5.2 Differential abundance between genetic subtypes](05.2_PT_DE_DA.html)
6. Validation by correlation with reference scRNA-seq datasets
    - [6.1 Adrenal-gland (AD) fetal reference](06.1_correlation_AD.html)
    - [6.2 Fetahu et al.](06.2_correlation_Fetahu.html)
    - [6.3 Jansky et al.](06.3_correlation_Jansky.html)
    - [6.4 Lee et al.](06.4_correlation_Lee.html)

## Adrenal-gland (AD) reference pipeline

The AD reference cohort is processed by a parallel pipeline in `analysis_AD/`
(read data → QC → phenotyping). It produces the reference object consumed by
step 6.1 above.

## Separate analyses

- [Spatial analysis in primary tumors](10_spatial_analysis.html) — kept separate
  because it requires a different Docker image (`lazdaria/mapmetsc_spatial`, for
  the imcRtools `testInteractions` fix); see the note at the top of the script.
